passages.provision_quote: A firearm industry member shall not advertise, market, or arrange for placement of an advertising or marketing communication concerning any firearm-related product in a manner that is designed, intended, or reasonably appears to be attractive to minors.
passages.note: The bill restricts firearm marketing aimed at minors, a dimension none of the rungs order.

rows.reasoning: The only source is AB 2571 (2021-2022), which she authored; its operative section bars a firearm industry member from marketing "any firearm-related product in a manner that is designed, intended, or reasonably appears to be attractive to minors." The rungs separate on which firearms may be owned, whether "universal background checks on every sale" are required, and whether carry rules are loosened or restrictions repealed; an advertising restriction speaks to none of those clauses, so no passage survives relevance.
